note: Repository presence is never runtime activation. Each stage below is proven separately and must not be collapsed.

sandbox_enabled.evidence: test/pandora-skills-runtime.test.js and test/pandora-capability-fabric.test.js prove core discovery, 144 generated capability skills, routing, kill switch, readiness gates, and mutation-boundary behavior.

canonical_source_enabled.evidence: Canonical source contains 51 static core skills plus 144 deterministic capability-fabric skills generated from 48 packs / 377 capability classes.

deployed.evidence: A production deployment must bind the exact merged source containing the capability fabric, skill runtime, packaging, and MCP surface before this stage becomes true.

production_authorized.evidence: Owner explicitly authorized adding the complete capability and skill expansion on 2026-09-27. Provider-specific legal, privacy, spending, destructive, and regulatory gates remain independent.

production_verified.evidence: Requires exact-source production deployment plus live health and authenticated MCP catalog/search/readiness/skill readback.

kill_switch.behaviour: Skill routing and loading raise SkillsDisabledError. No ungoverned fallback path exists.
kill_switch.rollback: Setting the variable to false restores pre-activation behaviour without deleting the catalog or any historical evidence.

mutation_authority.path: Pandora Runtime + Tool Gateway plan -> approval where required -> one-time execute -> provider readback -> evidence -> proof-stage update
